observations: The page number «94» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01: «coeli huius horoscopi et imminentis capitibus nostris.», in italics, completes the Latin words «interstitium medii» at the end of p. 93 (JP2 0125, L39); the Latin of chapter 34 (p. 29, JP2 0061, L01-L02) has «interstitium medii caeli huius horoscopi et imminentis capitibus nostris», «caeli» where Suter writes «coeli».

L01-L07. Checked: the corrected argument of latitude of p. 84 (JP2 0116, L11), 169° 7′ 31″, «169° 7½′»; sin q = sin 4° 30′ · sin 10° 52½′ gives q = 50′ 53″, the 50′ 53″ of Table 26 (the argument less than 180°, the latitude north); 57° 34′ 38″ − 50′ 53″ = 56° 43′ 45″. The parallax 40′ 43″ of Table 77 is to be compared with the table. L08-L13: Theon's tables in al-Battānī give c. 35′ and c. 47′; 47′ − 40′ 43″ = 6′ 17″, «um 6′».

L16-L20: the limits of the argument of latitude for a solar eclipse, mirror images of one another about the nodes: al-Khwārizmī 180° − 7° 11′ to 180° + 7° 30′ and 360° − 7° 30′ to 7° 11′; al-Battānī 180° − 20° 16′ to 180° + 11° 16′ and 360° − 11° 16′ to 20° 16′. Checked: 169° 7½′ lies outside al-Khwārizmī's limits (172° 49′) and inside al-Battānī's (159° 44′), as L27-L30 say. The values of Table 78 are to be compared with the table.

L33-L34: the two values, set in a centred block, the names joined to the figures by dotted leaders (five and four points), not transcribed. Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|»; the empty cells give the block room and are not printed. L35-L37 and N02. Checked: 50′ 53″ − 40′ 43″ = 10′ 10″; 58′ 25″ − 47′ = 11′ 25″.

L13: «keine ganz befriedigende Resultate», as printed, the strong ending after «keine», as «gar keine trigonometrische Ableitungen» (p. 92, JP2 0124, L15). L02 and L28: «169° 7 1/2′», the fraction small, the 1 raised.

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Theons», «Theon’schen», «Batt.», «Kh.», «Nallino»; italics: the Latin of L01, «Breite» (L01, L05), «Parallaxe», «südlich», «Medium Coelum», «pro spatio longinquo», «pro spatio propinquo», «Tabulae proportionis,», «Breite nördlich», «schein-». L14-L15: the heading of chapter 35, in bold, centred, with the reference to the text below it.
The dashes: L10 «79—81», L26 «73—76», L27 «82—84», the long dash set close; N02 «58′ 25″ — 47′», the minus a long dash with a space on either side.
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (8-13 px measured).
